''See also: [[Capital Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Capital is the massive, sprawling center of the [[Aurelian Empire]]. It is a vast urban expanse characterized by ancient spires, gleaming clock-towers, and dense clusters of buildings. The city is home to a diverse population ranging from dignified citizens with dark [[Heartlander]] skin to various mixed-breed peasants. Within the city, there are specialized locations such as a military harbor surrounded by cliffs, several chapter houses for various [[Guilds]]—including the [[Consultants]] and [[Navigators]]—and numerous mansions. The city is also known for its constant noise, with bells frequently ringing and streets that rarely experience silence. A central feature of the Capital is the [[Imperial]] Palace, a massive complex that accounts for approximately one-fifth to twenty percent of the city's total size. The palace is often described as a city unto itself, housing tens of thousands of inhabitants and staff who maintain a distinct social existence from the rest of the city's population. The palace contains various structures, such as the [[Rose Tower]] and the Emperor's personal chambers, which house the [[Optasia]]. The [[Optasia]] serves as the true throne of the Emperor, acting as a centerpiece for a global network of receptors and statues designed to channel power and monitor the [[Great Elders]]. The Capital has historically been a symbol of [[Imperial]] stability and civilization, though it has faced periods of extreme turmoil. Following the death of the Emperor, the city experienced chaos, including looting and fires. It has also been a target for Elder-related disasters; one such event saw an entire section of the city destroyed by the power of a [[Great Elder]], resulting in massive loss of life. Despite these threats, the city remains a vital hub for commerce, industry, and the various [[Guilds]] that govern [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]].}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Capital is a city defined by its ancient spires and gleaming clock-towers, standing as a place that night cannot conquer. Its various districts house the wealthy and contain numerous [[Imperial]] homes. To maintain the city's operations and fund the [[Imperial Guard]], resources are drawn from the [[Imperial]] Palace. However, following the death of the Emperor, the Capital was swallowed in chaos for several months.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Located within the [[Aurelian Empire]], the Capital stands as the greatest city in the world. It is a place filled with the scent of pine and serves as a hub where citizens and magicians alike can find work for hire. [[Shera]] spent her entire life in this city, which also houses a [[Kanatalia]] chapter house and remains an environment where even the Emperor would look at home. While the Captain intends to travel there, [[Shera]] is currently preparing to return to a desk job within its walls.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Capital experienced a massive surge in population during the coronation, though its military harbor remains small in comparison to [[Candle Bay]]. This location, which houses a [[Navigator chapter house]] and an [[Imperial]] Palace occupying nearly twenty percent of the city, is visible through a rift in the void. While [[Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss]] once attempted to transport herself directly there, the city is also known as the place from which [[Tommison{{!}}Captain Tommison]] sailed. During a period of intense chaos, citizens gathered amidst streets lit by [[sunset-orange quicklamps]] as news spread that the [[Imperial]] Palace had fallen and champions were being found dead throughout the city. Despite this turmoil, the Capital contains a high concentration of [[Optasia]] statues and is protected by wards against the [[Elders]] as well as the [[White Sun]]. In a vision, [[Calder]] was seen sitting on a throne at the center of the city before he flew back through it.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As the largest city in the world, the Capital is situated near [[Rainworth]] and features a mundane landscape of streets and traffic. While the [[Independents]] have fortified a hotel on its outskirts, many companies within the city hold contracts from the [[Imperialist Guilds]] or the throne. During a period of tension, wagons prepared for retreat and an evacuation began to take place. The city's situation turned dire when the sun darkened at midday and an entire section of the location vanished, leaving [[Loreli]] desperate to reach the site.}}
